FULL TEXT:
RABINDRA BHARATI UNIVERSITY
Emerald Bower Campus: 56 A B.T. Road, Kolkata-700050
Ref. No.: SFC/314/26 Date: 23/09/2026
This is to information of all concerned that the list of all applicants (Master list) for admission to 2
year integrated Master of Library and Information Science (dual degree: B.Lib.I.Sc +
M.Lib.I.Sc.), B.Ed. Special Education in Visual Impairment, B.Ed. Special Education in
Hearing Impairment, Diploma in Tagore Literature Programme under the Faculty of Arts in the
session 2026-2027 is published on the University admission portal (https://online.rbu.net.in).
1. For 2 year integrated Master of Library and Information Science Programme;
a) Rectification : If any anomalies found in the Master list, the candidates are strongly advised
to rectify the anomalies through online portal by 25/09/2026.
b) Download Admit Card : From 26/09/2026
c) Admission test : 29/09/2026 at 12.00 noon.
d) Merit list publication : 05/10/2026
2. For B.Ed. Special Education in Visual Impairment, B.Ed. Special Education in Hearing
Impairment
a) Rectification : If any anomalies found in the Master list, the candidates are strongly advised
to rectify the anomalies through online portal by 25/09/2026.
b) Merit list publication : 05/10/2026
3. For Diploma in Tagore Literature programme merit list will be published on 25/09/2026.
Sd.
Secretary, Faculty Councils
